virtual-enclaves-full-hour-billing.title: A short-lived enclave is still billed for every started hour
virtual-enclaves-full-hour-billing.body: This estimate runs each enclave for less than a full month. Enclave time is rounded up to whole hours, so very short test or demo enclaves cost a full hour each time they are created, and deleting and recreating enclaves repeatedly adds up.

citation.quote: Enclaves deployed during part of an hour are charged for the full hour.
